description: Source code for the OctoUtils class, providing utility functions for handling blocks, filtering, and duplication within a web application related to Mattermost's Focalboard project.

classes.name: OctoUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for hydrating, merging, duplicating blocks, and handling filter conditions within the application.

methods.name: hydrateBlock
methods.description: Creates a block instance based on its type, hydrating it with appropriate properties.

methods.name: mergeBlocks
methods.description: Merges two arrays of blocks, updating existing blocks and adding new ones.

methods.name: duplicateBlockTree
methods.description: Duplicates a tree of blocks, assigning new IDs and optionally remapping board and parent IDs.

methods.name: filterConditionDisplayString
methods.description: Returns a localized display string for a filter condition based on its type and value.

methods.name: filterConditionValidOrDefault
methods.description: Validates or defaults a filter condition based on its value type.
